title: Document every CLI flag in the README
probes: The DOC path on its own. There is no production code to write, so a chain that insists on a code change is over-reaching.
description:
The sandbox CLI README lists a couple of commands and stops. `add` alone accepts `--due`, `--priority` and repeated tag arguments, and `list` accepts `--all`, `--overdue` and `--tag`; none are documented.

Document every command and every flag the CLI actually accepts, with one worked example each, plus the `TODO_FILE` environment variable. Read the source to find them rather than trusting the current README.

Accuracy matters more than length: a documented flag that does not exist is worse than an undocumented one.
